explanation: The statement is about the library's own recursive definition `classicalWordSplits`, which doubles a list of (left, right) word splits for each letter. The theorem is a wrapper around `Classical.classicalWordSplits_leftLength_count`, which belongs to the library, not Mathlib. Mathlib has no `classicalWordSplits` and no similar list-split definition. Any Mathlib proof would have to go through a bijection with sublists or subsets and a binomial count. That takes real work, so I found no one-or-two-line derivation.
